actors.name: Marine Le Pen
actors.blurb: Marine Le Pen is shaping European and French headlines by declaring she will cut France's financial aid to Ukraine within six months if elected president in 2027. She is also facing diplomatic isolation in Brussels after threatening a showdown over France's European financial contributions, and demanding the resignation of a political opponent over a disputed constitutional referendum.
